import asyncio,json,os,sys,stat
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/telegram-robot-leads/scripts')
from telethon_sessions import inspect,make_memory_client
from organic_growth import read_model
vault=Path('/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads')
config=inspect(vault)
model=read_model(vault,config['group'])
print('MODEL_BEFORE',json.dumps({k:model.get(k) for k in ('schema','target_group','approve_join_requests','owned_channel','publish_in_owned_channel','publisher_account')},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
print('SESSION_AUTH_SOURCE',config['api_source'],'COUNT',len(config['entries']),flush=True)
async def check(entry):
 number=entry['index']
 client=make_memory_client(entry,config)
 try:
  await asyncio.wait_for(client.connect(),timeout=25)
  authorized=await asyncio.wait_for(client.is_user_authorized(),timeout=20)
  if not authorized:
   print('ACCOUNT',number,'AUTHORIZED',False,flush=True);return
  channel=await asyncio.wait_for(client.get_entity('@VPNCODEIPTV'),timeout=25)
  label=str(getattr(channel,'username','') or '')
  isbroadcast=getattr(channel,'broadcast',False) is True
  isgroup=getattr(channel,'megagroup',False) is True
  rights=getattr(channel,'admin_rights',None)
  creator=getattr(channel,'creator',False) is True
  canpost=bool(creator or getattr(rights,'post_messages',False) is True)
  print('CHANNEL',number,'HANDLE',label,'BROADCAST',isbroadcast,'MEGAGROUP',isgroup,'CREATOR',creator,'CAN_POST',canpost,flush=True)
  try:
   perm=await asyncio.wait_for(client.get_permissions(channel,'me'),timeout=20)
   print('MEMBER_PERMISSION',number,'IS_ADMIN',getattr(perm,'is_admin',None),'IS_CREATOR',getattr(perm,'is_creator',None),'CAN_POST',getattr(perm,'post_messages',None),flush=True)
  except Exception as exc:
   print('MEMBER_PERMISSION',number,'UNVERIFIED',type(exc).__name__,flush=True)
 except Exception as exc:
  print('ACCOUNT',number,'CHANNEL_CHECK_FAILED',type(exc).__name__,flush=True)
 finally:
  if client.is_connected():await asyncio.wait_for(client.disconnect(),timeout=10)
async def main():
 for e in config['entries']:
  await check(e)
asyncio.run(main())
print('READ_ONLY_CHANNEL_INSPECTION_DONE',flush=True)
